'''August 2000 Centerville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Schumers Cards and Comics, Centerville, Ohio on 26 August 2000. [[Russell Hockenberry]] won it. It is known from Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1164">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-27-centerville-ohio-8-26-00d1164/ centerville-ohio-8-26-00], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 27 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-27-centerville-ohio-8-26-00d1164/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Schumers Cards and Comics, Centerville, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Russell Hockenberry]]
